findings.disposition_rationale: 8aeef846: the new tests remove every mkdtemp directory in an after hook; verified with an isolated TMPDIR (0 left).
10a8aecd: realSources() skips non-string include entries, matching the manifest writer.

exit 2 from realSources() is the spec-required CLI contract and its only programmatic caller (the test) runs it in a subprocess; MINT_FILE and the scanned paths both derive from the same resolved repo path, so case or symlink variance cannot split them in practice.
test/ids.test.mjs pins ID_KINDS to the nine kinds and derives each parse<Kind> from the kind name, so drift between the union, the array and the exports fails a test.
check mode decides on byte equality; the differing-keys list is a diagnostic only.
the integrity message names the mismatch class and the remedy (npm ci); the hashes add nothing actionable.
